mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend

The project's current recorded decision is to use Rustls as the TLS backend, chosen because it is a better fit for the Rust codebase, has had fewer CVEs, and is simpler. This decision has not been changed by later recorded decisions on TLS usage (HTTPS everywhere with no plaintext exception, and self-signed certificates for testing), which concern where and how TLS is used rather than which backend provides it.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md
